ko.title: 임명되었고, 지지받았으며, 아직 당선되지 않은: 형의 상원 의석을 지키려는 달린 그레이엄의 투쟁

segments.src: ## A Seat Filled by Family, Now Facing the Voters
segments.tr: ## 가족이 채운 자리, 이제 유권자들 앞에 서다

segments.src: South Carolina's political calendar has an unusual date circled this month: August 25.
segments.tr: 사우스캐롤라이나의 정치 일정에 이번 달 특별한 날짜가 표시되어 있다: 8월 25일.

segments.src: That is when Republican voters head back to the polls for a runoff that will decide who represents the state in the U.S.
segments.tr: 그날 공화당 유권자들이 재투표를 위해 다시 투표소로 나가는데, 이는 미국 상원에서 그 주를 대표할 사람을 결정할 것이다.

segments.src: Senate for the remainder of a term that began with tragedy and has continued under intense national scrutiny.
segments.tr: 비극으로 시작되었으며 격렬한 국가적 감시 속에서 계속되어 온 임기의 나머지를 위한 상원.

segments.src: The seat became vacant after Senator Lindsey Graham died while still in office, ending more than two decades of service in Washington.
segments.tr: 상원의원 린지 그레이엄이 현직 중 사망한 후 그 자리가 공석이 되었으며, 이로써 워싱턴에서의 20년 이상의 봉사 경력이 끝났다.

segments.src: Under South Carolina's succession process, the governor was empowered to appoint a temporary replacement to serve until voters could weigh in through a special election.
segments.tr: 사우스캐롤라이나의 후임 절차에 따라 주지사는 유권자들이 특별선거를 통해 의견을 낼 때까지 봉사할 임시 교체자를 임명할 권한을 가졌다.

segments.src: The choice fell to someone with an unmistakable personal connection to the seat: Darline Graham, the senator's sister.
segments.tr: 그 선택은 그 자리와 명확한 개인적 연결이 있는 사람에게 떨어졌다: 상원의원의 여동생인 달린 그레이엄.

segments.src: ## From Appointment to Campaign Trail
segments.tr: ## 임명에서 선거운동까지

segments.src: Being appointed to fill a vacancy is one thing; winning the right to keep the job is another.
segments.tr: 공석을 채우도록 임명되는 것은 하나의 문제이고, 그 직책을 유지할 권리를 얻는 것은 또 다른 문제이다.

segments.src: South Carolina law requires a special election to fill the remainder of the term, and that contest has now advanced to a Republican runoff, a sign that the initial primary field was crowded enough that no single candidate cleared the threshold needed to win outright.
segments.tr: 사우스캐롤라이나 법에 따르면 임기의 나머지를 채우기 위해 특별선거를 실시해야 하며, 이 선거는 이제 공화당 재투표로 진행되었는데, 이는 초기 예비선거가 충분히 혼전이었으며 어떤 후보도 직접 승리하는 데 필요한 득표율을 얻지 못했다는 신호이다.

segments.src: Darline Graham entered the race carrying both an advantage and a burden.
segments.tr: 달린 그레이엄은 장점과 부담을 함께 안고 이 경쟁에 진입했다.

segments.src: The advantage is name recognition and the emotional resonance of continuing her brother's work; the burden is the perception, voiced by some rivals and commentators, that her rise to the Senate started with an appointment rather than a ballot box victory.
segments.tr: 장점은 명성과 형의 업적을 계속할 정서적 울림이며, 부담은 일부 라이벌과 평론가들이 제기한 그녀의 상원 진출이 투표가 아닌 임명으로 시작되었다는 인식이다.

segments.src: Her campaign has leaned into the former while trying to neutralize the latter, framing her appointment as a bridge to earning the seat directly from voters rather than an entitlement.
segments.tr: 그녀의 선거캠프는 전자에 집중하면서 후자를 중화하려고 노력했으며, 그녀의 임명을 권리 주장이 아닌 유권자들로부터 직접 그 자리를 얻기 위한 징검다리로 구성했다.

segments.src: ## The Trump Factor
segments.tr: ## 트럼프 요소

segments.src: The runoff has drawn outsized attention in part because of an endorsement from President Trump, who threw his support behind Graham's candidacy.
segments.tr: 이 재투표가 과도한 관심을 끈 것은 부분적으로 트럼프 대통령이 그레이엄의 입후보를 지지했기 때문이다.

segments.src: In modern South Carolina Republican politics, a presidential endorsement can be decisive, often reshaping turnout and consolidating support among the party's base heading into a runoff.
segments.tr: 현대 사우스캐롤라이나 공화당 정치에서 대통령의 지지는 결정적일 수 있으며, 종종 투표율을 재편성하고 재투표를 앞두고 당의 기층 지지자들을 결집시킨다.

segments.src: Graham's team has featured the endorsement prominently in campaign messaging, betting that it will help her fend off a challenger seeking to portray the race as a referendum on whether Senate seats should pass within a family rather than being won through a traditional political career.
segments.tr: 그레이엄의 팀은 이 지지를 선거 메시지에서 두드러지게 부각시켰으며, 이것이 상원의원 자리가 가족 내에서 세습되어야 하는지 여부에 대한 국민 투표로 경쟁을 표현하려는 도전자를 격퇴하는 데 도움이 될 것이라고 기대했다.

segments.src: Her runoff opponent has instead emphasized a message of earned service, arguing that voters deserve a senator who built a political record independent of a family name.
segments.tr: 그녀의 재투표 상대는 대신 획득된 봉사의 메시지를 강조했으며, 유권자들은 가족 이름과 무관하게 정치적 기록을 구축한 상원의원을 받을 자격이 있다고 주장했다.

segments.src: That argument has found some traction among South Carolina Republicans wary of dynastic politics, even within a party that has generally rallied around the Graham family since the senator's death.
segments.tr: 이 주장은 왕조 정치를 경계하는 사우스캐롤라이나 공화당원들 사이에서 어느 정도 지지를 받았으며, 상원의원 사망 이후 그레이엄 가족을 중심으로 일반적으로 결집해 온 당 내에서도 그러하다.

segments.src: ## What the Runoff Actually Decides
segments.tr: ## 재투표가 실제로 결정하는 것

segments.src: It is worth being precise about what is, and is not, on the ballot August 25.
segments.tr: 8월 25일 투표지에 무엇이 있고 무엇이 없는지에 대해 명확히 하는 것이 중요하다.

segments.src: The runoff will determine the Republican nominee for the special election to complete the remainder of Lindsey Graham's term, not a full six-year term in its own right.
segments.tr: 이 재투표는 린지 그레이엄 임기의 나머지를 완료하기 위한 특별선거의 공화당 후보자를 결정할 것이며, 그 자체로 완전한 6년 임기를 결정하는 것이 아니다.

segments.src: Whoever wins the runoff will still need to prevail in the special general election against Democratic and any third-party candidates before formally winning the seat by vote rather than appointment.
segments.tr: 재투표에서 이기는 누구든지 임명이 아닌 투표로 그 자리를 공식적으로 얻기 전에 민주당 및 제3정당 후보들을 상대로 하는 특별 총선거에서도 승리해야 한다.

segments.src: For Darline Graham, that means the political test is really twofold: first, consolidating Republican support in a state where the GOP nomination is often the decisive contest, and second, defending the seat again in the general election.
segments.tr: 달린 그레이엄에게 이는 정치적 시험이 실제로 두 가지라는 의미이다: 첫째, GOP 후보 지명이 종종 결정적인 경쟁인 주에서 공화당 지지를 결집시키는 것, 그리고 둘째, 총선거에서 다시 그 자리를 수호하는 것이다.

segments.src: Her supporters argue that a decisive runoff win, especially with a presidential endorsement in hand, would send a strong signal heading into that later contest.
segments.tr: 그녀의 지지자들은 특히 대통령의 지지를 등에 업은 결정적인 재투표 승리가 그 이후 경쟁으로 향할 때 강한 신호를 보낼 것이라고 주장한다.

segments.src: ## A Test of Legacy Politics in a Changing South Carolina
segments.tr: ## 변화하는 사우스캐롤라이나에서 유산 정치의 시험

segments.src: Beyond the personalities involved, the race has become something of a case study in how American voters respond to family succession in elected office, a dynamic more commonly associated with congressional dynasties in other states than with South Carolina's Senate seats.
segments.tr: 관련된 개인들을 넘어서, 이 경쟁은 미국 유권자들이 선출직의 가족 세습에 어떻게 반응하는지에 대한 사례 연구가 되었으며, 이는 사우스캐롤라이나의 상원의원 자리보다는 다른 주의 의회 왕조와 더 일반적으로 연관되는 현상이다.

segments.src: Political analysts have noted that appointed successors historically have a mixed track record when they later face voters directly, with outcomes often depending less on the family connection itself and more on how effectively the appointee builds an independent political identity during their time in office.
segments.tr: 정치 분석가들은 임명된 후임자들이 나중에 유권자들과 직면할 때 역사적으로 엇갈린 실적을 가지고 있다고 지적했으며, 결과는 종종 가족 연결 자체보다는 임명인이 현직 기간 동안 독립적인 정치 정체성을 얼마나 효과적으로 구축하는지에 따라 달라진다.

segments.src: Turnout in runoff elections tends to be lower and more ideologically driven than in primaries or general elections, which could amplify the impact of the Trump endorsement among the most engaged Republican voters.
segments.tr: 재투표 선거의 투표율은 예비선거나 총선거보다 낮으며 더 이념적으로 주도되는 경향을 보이는데, 이는 가장 참여도가 높은 공화당 유권자들 사이에서 트럼프 지지의 영향을 증폭시킬 수 있다.

segments.src: Local officials have urged residents to check their polling locations and eligibility ahead of the August 25 vote, since runoff participation rules can differ slightly from the initial primary.
segments.tr: 지방 관계자들은 재투표 참여 규칙이 초기 예비선거와 약간 다를 수 있으므로 8월 25일 투표 전에 주민들에게 자신의 투표소와 적격성을 확인하도록 촉구했다.

segments.src: Whatever the outcome, the result will offer an early, closely watched signal of how South Carolina Republicans view the balance between honoring a political legacy and insisting that every seat in the Senate be won, not simply inherited.
segments.tr: 결과가 어떻든 간에, 그 결과는 사우스캐롤라이나 공화당원들이 정치적 유산을 존중하는 것과 상원의원의 모든 자리가 단순히 세습되는 것이 아니라 얻어져야 한다는 것 사이의 균형을 어떻게 보는지에 대한 초기의, 주목할 만한 신호를 제공할 것이다.

zh.title: 被任命、获支持、未当选：达琳·格雷厄姆争取保住兄长参议员席位的内幕

segments.src: ## A Seat Filled by Family, Now Facing the Voters
segments.tr: ## 由家族成员填补的席位，现面临选民考验

segments.src: South Carolina's political calendar has an unusual date circled this month: August 25.
segments.tr: 南卡罗来纳州的政治日程表在本月标记了一个不寻常的日期：8月25日。

segments.src: That is when Republican voters head back to the polls for a runoff that will decide who represents the state in the U.S.
segments.tr: 那是共和党选民返回投票站参加决选的日期，该决选将决定谁在美国

segments.src: Senate for the remainder of a term that began with tragedy and has continued under intense national scrutiny.
segments.tr: 参议院代表该州任期的剩余部分——该任期始于悲剧，一直在全国强烈关注下进行。

segments.src: The seat became vacant after Senator Lindsey Graham died while still in office, ending more than two decades of service in Washington.
segments.tr: 参议员林赛·格雷厄姆在任期间去世后，该席位空缺，结束了他在华盛顿二十多年的服务。

segments.src: Under South Carolina's succession process, the governor was empowered to appoint a temporary replacement to serve until voters could weigh in through a special election.
segments.tr: 根据南卡罗来纳州的继任程序，州长被授权任命一位临时替代人选，直到选民通过特殊选举发表意见。

segments.src: The choice fell to someone with an unmistakable personal connection to the seat: Darline Graham, the senator's sister.
segments.tr: 这个选择落在了一个与该席位有明确个人联系的人身上：参议员的妹妹达琳·格雷厄姆。

segments.src: ## From Appointment to Campaign Trail
segments.tr: ## 从任命到竞选之路

segments.src: Being appointed to fill a vacancy is one thing; winning the right to keep the job is another.
segments.tr: 被任命填补空缺是一回事；赢得保住这份工作的权利是另一回事。

segments.src: South Carolina law requires a special election to fill the remainder of the term, and that contest has now advanced to a Republican runoff, a sign that the initial primary field was crowded enough that no single candidate cleared the threshold needed to win outright.
segments.tr: 南卡罗来纳州法律要求进行特殊选举来填补任期的剩余部分。该竞争现已进入共和党决选，表明初始初选领域足够拥挤，以至于没有单一候选人达到直接获胜所需的门槛。

segments.src: Darline Graham entered the race carrying both an advantage and a burden.
segments.tr: 达琳·格雷厄姆带着优势和负担进入了竞选。

segments.src: The advantage is name recognition and the emotional resonance of continuing her brother's work; the burden is the perception, voiced by some rivals and commentators, that her rise to the Senate started with an appointment rather than a ballot box victory.
segments.tr: 优势是名气和继续兄长工作的情感共鸣；负担是一些竞争对手和评论员提出的看法，即她在参议院的崛起始于任命而不是投票箱的胜利。

segments.src: Her campaign has leaned into the former while trying to neutralize the latter, framing her appointment as a bridge to earning the seat directly from voters rather than an entitlement.
segments.tr: 她的竞选活动强调了优势，同时试图消除负担，将她的任命描绘为从选民那里直接赢得席位的桥梁，而不是一种权利。

segments.src: ## The Trump Factor
segments.tr: ## 特朗普因素

segments.src: The runoff has drawn outsized attention in part because of an endorsement from President Trump, who threw his support behind Graham's candidacy.
segments.tr: 决选吸引了过多关注，部分原因是特朗普总统的支持，他支持了格雷厄姆的候选资格。

segments.src: In modern South Carolina Republican politics, a presidential endorsement can be decisive, often reshaping turnout and consolidating support among the party's base heading into a runoff.
segments.tr: 在现代南卡罗来纳州共和党政治中，总统支持可能是决定性的，通常会重新塑造投票率，并在进入决选前巩固党派基础的支持。

segments.src: Graham's team has featured the endorsement prominently in campaign messaging, betting that it will help her fend off a challenger seeking to portray the race as a referendum on whether Senate seats should pass within a family rather than being won through a traditional political career.
segments.tr: 格雷厄姆的团队在竞选信息中突出了这一支持，赌这将帮助她击退一位试图将竞选描绘为全民公投的挑战者——即参议院席位是否应在家族内传递还是通过传统政治生涯赢得。

segments.src: Her runoff opponent has instead emphasized a message of earned service, arguing that voters deserve a senator who built a political record independent of a family name.
segments.tr: 她的决选对手则强调了服务应该通过自己的努力赢得这一信息，辩称选民应该拥有一位独立于家族名字建立政治记录的参议员。

segments.src: That argument has found some traction among South Carolina Republicans wary of dynastic politics, even within a party that has generally rallied around the Graham family since the senator's death.
segments.tr: 这一论点在警惕世袭政治的南卡罗来纳州共和党人中获得了一些支持，即使在自参议员去世以来普遍围绕格雷厄姆家族的政党内也是如此。

segments.src: ## What the Runoff Actually Decides
segments.tr: ## 决选实际上决定了什么

segments.src: It is worth being precise about what is, and is not, on the ballot August 25.
segments.tr: 值得精确说明8月25日投票中包括什么和不包括什么。

segments.src: The runoff will determine the Republican nominee for the special election to complete the remainder of Lindsey Graham's term, not a full six-year term in its own right.
segments.tr: 决选将确定共和党提名人选，参加特殊选举以完成林赛·格雷厄姆任期的剩余部分，而不是确定一个完整的六年任期。

segments.src: Whoever wins the runoff will still need to prevail in the special general election against Democratic and any third-party candidates before formally winning the seat by vote rather than appointment.
segments.tr: 决选的赢家仍然需要在特殊全民选举中战胜民主党和任何第三方候选人，然后才能通过投票而不是任命正式赢得席位。

segments.src: For Darline Graham, that means the political test is really twofold: first, consolidating Republican support in a state where the GOP nomination is often the decisive contest, and second, defending the seat again in the general election.
segments.tr: 对达琳·格雷厄姆来说，这意味着政治考验实际上是双重的：首先，在共和党提名通常是决定性竞争的州巩固共和党支持，其次，在全民选举中再次捍卫席位。

segments.src: Her supporters argue that a decisive runoff win, especially with a presidential endorsement in hand, would send a strong signal heading into that later contest.
segments.tr: 她的支持者辩称，决定性的决选胜利，特别是有总统支持的情况下，会为稍后的竞争发出强烈信号。

segments.src: ## A Test of Legacy Politics in a Changing South Carolina
segments.tr: ## 变化中的南卡罗来纳州对遗产政治的检验

segments.src: Beyond the personalities involved, the race has become something of a case study in how American voters respond to family succession in elected office, a dynamic more commonly associated with congressional dynasties in other states than with South Carolina's Senate seats.
segments.tr: 除了涉及的人物外，这场竞选已成为美国选民如何应对当选官职中的家族继承的案例研究，这种动态通常与其他州的国会世家相关，而不是南卡罗来纳州的参议院席位。

segments.src: Political analysts have noted that appointed successors historically have a mixed track record when they later face voters directly, with outcomes often depending less on the family connection itself and more on how effectively the appointee builds an independent political identity during their time in office.
segments.tr: 政治分析家指出，任命的继任者在随后直接面对选民时历史上成绩参差不齐，结果通常不太取决于家族联系本身，而更多取决于任命者在任期间如何有效建立独立的政治身份。

segments.src: Turnout in runoff elections tends to be lower and more ideologically driven than in primaries or general elections, which could amplify the impact of the Trump endorsement among the most engaged Republican voters.
segments.tr: 决选中的投票率往往比初选或全民选举中的投票率更低，且意识形态驱动力更强，这可能会放大特朗普支持在最积极的共和党选民中的影响。

segments.src: Local officials have urged residents to check their polling locations and eligibility ahead of the August 25 vote, since runoff participation rules can differ slightly from the initial primary.
segments.tr: 地方官员敦促居民在8月25日投票前检查他们的投票地点和资格，因为决选参与规则可能与初选略有不同。

segments.src: ## A Seat Filled by Family, Now Facing the Voters
segments.tr: ## एक सीट परिवार द्वारा भरी गई, अब मतदाताओं का सामना कर रही है

segments.src: South Carolina's political calendar has an unusual date circled this month: August 25.
segments.tr: दक्षिण कैरोलिना के राजनीतिक कैलेंडर में इस महीने एक असामान्य तारीख है: 25 अगस्त।

segments.src: That is when Republican voters head back to the polls for a runoff that will decide who represents the state in the U.S.
segments.tr: यह तब है जब रिपब्लिकन मतदाता एक रनऑफ के लिए मतदान केंद्रों पर वापस जाते हैं जो यह तय करेगा कि U.S. में राज्य का प्रतिनिधित्व कौन करेगा।

segments.src: Senate for the remainder of a term that began with tragedy and has continued under intense national scrutiny.
segments.tr: सीनेट एक कार्यकाल के शेष समय के लिए जो त्रासदी के साथ शुरू हुआ और तीव्र राष्ट्रीय जांच के तहत जारी रहा।

segments.src: The seat became vacant after Senator Lindsey Graham died while still in office, ending more than two decades of service in Washington.
segments.tr: सीनेटर लिंडसे ग्राहम की कार्यालय में रहते हुए मृत्यु के बाद सीट खाली हुई, वाशिंगटन में दो दशक से अधिक की सेवा को समाप्त करते हुए।

segments.src: Under South Carolina's succession process, the governor was empowered to appoint a temporary replacement to serve until voters could weigh in through a special election.
segments.tr: दक्षिण कैरोलिना की उत्तराधिकार प्रक्रिया के तहत, राज्यपाल को एक अस्थायी प्रतिस्थापन नियुक्त करने के लिए अधिकृत किया गया ताकि मतदाता एक विशेष चुनाव के माध्यम से अपनी राय दे सकें।

segments.src: The choice fell to someone with an unmistakable personal connection to the seat: Darline Graham, the senator's sister.
segments.tr: पसंद किसी ऐसे व्यक्ति पर पड़ी जिसका सीट से एक स्पष्ट व्यक्तिगत संबंध था: डार्लीन ग्राहम, सीनेटर की बहन।

segments.src: ## From Appointment to Campaign Trail
segments.tr: ## नियुक्ति से अभियान पथ तक

segments.src: Being appointed to fill a vacancy is one thing; winning the right to keep the job is another.
segments.tr: एक रिक्तता को भरने के लिए नियुक्त होना एक बात है; नौकरी को रखने का अधिकार जीतना दूसरी बात है।

segments.src: South Carolina law requires a special election to fill the remainder of the term, and that contest has now advanced to a Republican runoff, a sign that the initial primary field was crowded enough that no single candidate cleared the threshold needed to win outright.
segments.tr: दक्षिण कैरोलिना कानून को कार्यकाल के शेष को भरने के लिए एक विशेष चुनाव की आवश्यकता है, और वह प्रतियोगिता अब एक रिपब्लिकन रनऑफ तक पहुंच गई है, एक संकेत कि प्रारंभिक प्राथमिकता क्षेत्र काफी भीड़ भरा था कि कोई एकल उम्मीदवार पूरी तरह से जीतने के लिए आवश्यक सीमा पार नहीं कर सका।

segments.src: Darline Graham entered the race carrying both an advantage and a burden.
segments.tr: डार्लीन ग्राहम ने एक लाभ और एक बोझ दोनों के साथ दौड़ में प्रवेश किया।

segments.src: The advantage is name recognition and the emotional resonance of continuing her brother's work; the burden is the perception, voiced by some rivals and commentators, that her rise to the Senate started with an appointment rather than a ballot box victory.
segments.tr: लाभ नाम की पहचान और अपने भाई के काम को जारी रखने का भावनात्मक प्रभाव है; बोझ यह धारणा है, जो कुछ प्रतिद्वंद्वियों और टिप्पणीकारों द्वारा व्यक्त की गई है, कि सीनेट के लिए उसका उदय एक मतदान बॉक्स की जीत के बजाय एक नियुक्ति के साथ शुरू हुआ।

segments.src: Her campaign has leaned into the former while trying to neutralize the latter, framing her appointment as a bridge to earning the seat directly from voters rather than an entitlement.
segments.tr: उसके अभियान ने पूर्व की ओर झुका है जबकि बाद वाले को तटस्थ करने का प्रयास कर रहा है, उसकी नियुक्ति को एक हकदारी के बजाय मतदाताओं से सीधे सीट अर्जित करने के लिए एक पुल के रूप में तैयार कर रहा है।

segments.src: ## The Trump Factor
segments.tr: ## ट्रम्प कारक

segments.src: The runoff has drawn outsized attention in part because of an endorsement from President Trump, who threw his support behind Graham's candidacy.
segments.tr: रनऑफ ने राष्ट्रपति ट्रम्प की समर्थन के कारण बाहर से ध्यान आकर्षित किया है, जिन्होंने ग्राहम की उम्मीदवारी के पीछे अपना समर्थन दिया।

segments.src: In modern South Carolina Republican politics, a presidential endorsement can be decisive, often reshaping turnout and consolidating support among the party's base heading into a runoff.
segments.tr: आधुनिक दक्षिण कैरोलिना रिपब्लिकन राजनीति में, एक राष्ट्रपति समर्थन निर्णायक हो सकता है, अक्सर मतदान को फिर से आकार देता है और रनऑफ की ओर जाने वाली पार्टी के आधार में समर्थन को समेकित करता है।

segments.src: Graham's team has featured the endorsement prominently in campaign messaging, betting that it will help her fend off a challenger seeking to portray the race as a referendum on whether Senate seats should pass within a family rather than being won through a traditional political career.
segments.tr: ग्राहम की टीम ने अभियान संदेशों में समर्थन को प्रमुखता से दिखाया है, यह दांव लगाते हुए कि यह उसे एक चुनौती देने वाले को दूर करने में मदद करेगा जो दौड़ को इस बारे में एक जनमत संग्रह के रूप में चित्रित करने की कोशिश कर रहा है कि क्या सीनेट की सीटें परिवार के भीतर से गुजरनी चाहिए या एक पारंपरिक राजनीतिक करियर के माध्यम से जीती जानी चाहिए।

segments.src: Her runoff opponent has instead emphasized a message of earned service, arguing that voters deserve a senator who built a political record independent of a family name.
segments.tr: उसके रनऑफ प्रतिद्वंद्वी ने इसके बजाय अर्जित सेवा के एक संदेश पर जोर दिया है, तर्क देते हुए कि मतदाता एक सीनेटर के योग्य हैं जिन्होंने एक पारिवारिक नाम से स्वतंत्र एक राजनीतिक रिकॉर्ड बनाया।

segments.src: That argument has found some traction among South Carolina Republicans wary of dynastic politics, even within a party that has generally rallied around the Graham family since the senator's death.
segments.tr: वह तर्क दक्षिण कैरोलिना रिपब्लिकन के बीच कुछ ट्रैक्शन पाया है जो राजवंशीय राजनीति से सावधान हैं, यहां तक कि एक पार्टी के भीतर भी जो सीनेटर की मृत्यु के बाद से ग्राहम परिवार के चारों ओर आमतौर पर जुटी है।

segments.src: ## What the Runoff Actually Decides
segments.tr: ## रनऑफ वास्तव में क्या तय करता है

segments.src: It is worth being precise about what is, and is not, on the ballot August 25.
segments.tr: यह सटीक होने के लायक है कि 25 अगस्त को मतपत्र पर क्या है और क्या नहीं।

segments.src: The runoff will determine the Republican nominee for the special election to complete the remainder of Lindsey Graham's term, not a full six-year term in its own right.
segments.tr: रनऑफ लिंडसे ग्राहम के कार्यकाल के शेष को पूरा करने के लिए विशेष चुनाव के लिए रिपब्लिकन उम्मीदवार का निर्धारण करेगा, अपने आप में एक पूर्ण छह साल की अवधि नहीं।

segments.src: Whoever wins the runoff will still need to prevail in the special general election against Democratic and any third-party candidates before formally winning the seat by vote rather than appointment.
segments.tr: रनऑफ जीतने वाले को अभी भी नियुक्ति के बजाय वोट से सीट को औपचारिक रूप से जीतने से पहले डेमोक्रेटिक और किसी भी तीसरे पक्ष के उम्मीदवारों के खिलाफ विशेष आम चुनाव में विजयी होने की आवश्यकता होगी।

segments.src: For Darline Graham, that means the political test is really twofold: first, consolidating Republican support in a state where the GOP nomination is often the decisive contest, and second, defending the seat again in the general election.
segments.tr: डार्लीन ग्राहम के लिए, इसका मतलब है कि राजनीतिक परीक्षा वास्तव में दोगुनी है: पहला, एक राज्य में रिपब्लिकन समर्थन को समेकित करना जहां जीओपी नामांकन अक्सर निर्णायक प्रतियोगिता है, और दूसरा, आम चुनाव में फिर से सीट की रक्षा करना।

segments.src: Her supporters argue that a decisive runoff win, especially with a presidential endorsement in hand, would send a strong signal heading into that later contest.
segments.tr: उसके समर्थकों का तर्क है कि एक निर्णायक रनऑफ जीत, विशेषकर एक राष्ट्रपति समर्थन के साथ, उस बाद की प्रतियोगिता की ओर एक मजबूत संकेत भेजेगी।

segments.src: ## A Test of Legacy Politics in a Changing South Carolina
segments.tr: ## बदलते दक्षिण कैरोलिना में विरासत राजनीति की एक परीक्षा

segments.src: Beyond the personalities involved, the race has become something of a case study in how American voters respond to family succession in elected office, a dynamic more commonly associated with congressional dynasties in other states than with South Carolina's Senate seats.
segments.tr: शामिल व्यक्तित्वों से परे, दौड़ एक केस स्टडी बन गई है कि कैसे अमेरिकी मतदाता निर्वाचित कार्यालय में पारिवारिक उत्तराधिकार का जवाब देते हैं, एक गतिशीलता जो दक्षिण कैरोलिना की सीनेट सीटों की तुलना में अन्य राज्यों में कांग्रेसी राजवंशों के साथ अधिक आमतौर पर जुड़ी हुई है।

segments.src: Political analysts have noted that appointed successors historically have a mixed track record when they later face voters directly, with outcomes often depending less on the family connection itself and more on how effectively the appointee builds an independent political identity during their time in office.
segments.tr: राजनीतिक विश्लेषकों ने नोट किया है कि नियुक्त उत्तराधिकारियों के पास ऐतिहासिक रूप से एक मिश्रित ट्रैक रिकॉर्ड है जब वे बाद में सीधे मतदाताओं का सामना करते हैं, परिणाम अक्सर पारिवारिक संबंध ही पर कम निर्भर होते हैं और अधिक कि नियुक्त व्यक्ति अपने कार्यालय के समय में एक स्वतंत्र राजनीतिक पहचान कितनी प्रभावी रूप से बनाता है।

segments.src: Turnout in runoff elections tends to be lower and more ideologically driven than in primaries or general elections, which could amplify the impact of the Trump endorsement among the most engaged Republican voters.
segments.tr: रनऑफ चुनावों में मतदान प्राथमिकताओं या आम चुनावों की तुलना में कम और अधिक वैचारिक रूप से संचालित होता है, जो सबसे अधिक संलग्न रिपब्लिकन मतदाताओं के बीच ट्रम्प समर्थन के प्रभाव को बढ़ा सकता है।

segments.src: Local officials have urged residents to check their polling locations and eligibility ahead of the August 25 vote, since runoff participation rules can differ slightly from the initial primary.
segments.tr: स्थानीय अधिकारियों ने 25 अगस्त के मतदान से पहले निवासियों से अपने मतदान केंद्रों और पात्रता की जांच करने के लिए कहा है, क्योंकि रनऑफ भागीदारी नियम प्रारंभिक प्राथमिकता से थोड़ा भिन्न हो सकते हैं।

segments.src: Whatever the outcome, the result will offer an early, closely watched signal of how South Carolina Republicans view the balance between honoring a political legacy and insisting that every seat in the Senate be won, not simply inherited.
segments.tr: परिणाम चाहे कुछ भी हो, परिणाम यह एक प्रारंभिक, निकट से देखा जाने वाला संकेत प्रदान करेगा कि दक्षिण कैरोलिना रिपब्लिकन एक राजनीतिक विरासत को सम्मानित करने और यह जोर देने के बीच संतुलन को कैसे देखते हैं कि सीनेट में हर सीट जीती जाए, बस विरासत में न दी जाए।

es.title: Designada, Respaldada, Aún No Elegida: La Lucha de Darline Graham por Retener el Escaño del Senado de su Hermano

segments.src: Senate for the remainder of a term that began with tragedy and has continued under intense national scrutiny.

segments.src: ## From Appointment to Campaign Trail

segments.src: ## The Trump Factor

segments.src: ## What the Runoff Actually Decides
segments.tr: ## Lo que la Segunda Vuelta Realmente Decide

segments.src: It is worth being precise about what is, and is not, on the ballot August 25.
segments.tr: Vale la pena ser preciso sobre lo que está, y no está, en la boleta del 25 de agosto.

segments.src: The runoff will determine the Republican nominee for the special election to complete the remainder of Lindsey Graham's term, not a full six-year term in its own right.
segments.tr: La segunda vuelta determinará al nominado republicano para la elección especial que complete el resto del mandato de Lindsey Graham, no un mandato completo de seis años por derecho propio.

segments.src: Whoever wins the runoff will still need to prevail in the special general election against Democratic and any third-party candidates before formally winning the seat by vote rather than appointment.
segments.tr: Quienquiera que gane la segunda vuelta aún necesitará prevalecer en la elección general especial contra candidatos demócratas y de terceros antes de ganar formalmente el escaño por voto en lugar de designación.

segments.src: For Darline Graham, that means the political test is really twofold: first, consolidating Republican support in a state where the GOP nomination is often the decisive contest, and second, defending the seat again in the general election.
segments.tr: Para Darline Graham, eso significa que la prueba política es realmente doble: primero, consolidar el apoyo republicano en un estado donde la nominación del GOP a menudo es la contienda decisiva, y segundo, defender el escaño nuevamente en la elección general.

segments.src: Her supporters argue that a decisive runoff win, especially with a presidential endorsement in hand, would send a strong signal heading into that later contest.
segments.tr: Sus partidarios argumentan que una victoria decisiva en la segunda vuelta, especialmente con un respaldo presidencial en mano, enviaría una señal fuerte en el camino hacia esa contienda posterior.

segments.src: ## A Test of Legacy Politics in a Changing South Carolina
segments.tr: ## Una Prueba de la Política de Legado en una Carolina del Sur Cambiante

segments.src: Beyond the personalities involved, the race has become something of a case study in how American voters respond to family succession in elected office, a dynamic more commonly associated with congressional dynasties in other states than with South Carolina's Senate seats.
segments.tr: Más allá de las personalidades involucradas, la carrera se ha convertido en una especie de estudio de caso sobre cómo los votantes estadounidenses responden a la sucesión familiar en cargos electivos, una dinámica más comúnmente asociada con dinastías congresionales en otros estados que con los escaños del Senado de Carolina del Sur.

segments.src: Political analysts have noted that appointed successors historically have a mixed track record when they later face voters directly, with outcomes often depending less on the family connection itself and more on how effectively the appointee builds an independent political identity during their time in office.
segments.tr: Los analistas políticos han señalado que los sucesores designados históricamente tienen un historial mixto cuando luego enfrentan votantes directamente, con resultados que a menudo dependen menos de la conexión familiar en sí y más de qué tan efectivamente el designado construye una identidad política independiente durante su tiempo en funciones.

segments.src: Turnout in runoff elections tends to be lower and more ideologically driven than in primaries or general elections, which could amplify the impact of the Trump endorsement among the most engaged Republican voters.
segments.tr: La participación en elecciones de segunda vuelta tiende a ser más baja y más orientada ideológicamente que en primarias o elecciones generales, lo que podría amplificar el impacto del respaldo de Trump entre los votantes republicanos más comprometidos.

segments.src: Local officials have urged residents to check their polling locations and eligibility ahead of the August 25 vote, since runoff participation rules can differ slightly from the initial primary.
segments.tr: Los funcionarios locales han instado a los residentes a verificar sus lugares de votación y elegibilidad antes de la votación del 25 de agosto, ya que las reglas de participación en la segunda vuelta pueden diferir ligeramente de la primaria inicial.

segments.src: Whatever the outcome, the result will offer an early, closely watched signal of how South Carolina Republicans view the balance between honoring a political legacy and insisting that every seat in the Senate be won, not simply inherited.
segments.tr: Sea cual sea el resultado, el resultado ofrecerá una señal temprana y de cerca vigilada de cómo los republicanos de Carolina del Sur ven el equilibrio entre honrar un legado político e insistir en que cada escaño en el Senado sea ganado, no simplemente heredado.

ar.title: معيّن، مؤيد، لم ينتخب بعد: داخل نضال دارلين جراهام للاحتفاظ بمقعد أخيها بمجلس الشيوخ

segments.src: ## A Seat Filled by Family, Now Facing the Voters
segments.tr: ## مقعد ملأته الأسرة، والآن يواجه الناخبين

segments.src: South Carolina's political calendar has an unusual date circled this month: August 25.
segments.tr: يحتوي التقويم السياسي لولاية ساوث كارولينا على تاريخ غير عادي مميز هذا الشهر: 25 أغسطس.

segments.src: That is when Republican voters head back to the polls for a runoff that will decide who represents the state in the U.S.
segments.tr: هذا هو الوقت الذي يعود فيه الناخبون الجمهوريون إلى صناديق الاقتراع للتصويت في جولة إعادة ستحدد من سيمثل الولاية في مجلس الشيوخ الأمريكي.

segments.src: Senate for the remainder of a term that began with tragedy and has continued under intense national scrutiny.
segments.tr: للبقية من ولاية بدأت بمأساة واستمرت تحت مراقبة وطنية مكثفة.

segments.src: The seat became vacant after Senator Lindsey Graham died while still in office, ending more than two decades of service in Washington.
segments.tr: أصبح المقعد شاغراً بعد وفاة السيناتور ليندسي جراهام أثناء عمله، منهياً أكثر من عقدين من الخدمة في واشنطن.

segments.src: Under South Carolina's succession process, the governor was empowered to appoint a temporary replacement to serve until voters could weigh in through a special election.
segments.tr: بموجب عملية الخلافة في ولاية ساوث كارولينا، كان الحاكم مفوضاً بتعيين بديل مؤقت للخدمة حتى يتمكن الناخبون من الإدلاء برأيهم من خلال انتخابات خاصة.

segments.src: The choice fell to someone with an unmistakable personal connection to the seat: Darline Graham, the senator's sister.
segments.tr: وقع الاختيار على شخص له ارتباط شخصي واضح بالمقعد: دارلين جراهام، أخت السيناتور.

segments.src: ## From Appointment to Campaign Trail
segments.tr: ## من التعيين إلى حملة انتخابية

segments.src: Being appointed to fill a vacancy is one thing; winning the right to keep the job is another.
segments.tr: التعيين لملء شاغر أمر واحد؛ الفوز بالحق في الاحتفاظ بالوظيفة أمر آخر.

segments.src: South Carolina law requires a special election to fill the remainder of the term, and that contest has now advanced to a Republican runoff, a sign that the initial primary field was crowded enough that no single candidate cleared the threshold needed to win outright.
segments.tr: يتطلب قانون ساوث كارولينا انتخابات خاصة لملء بقية المدة الزمنية، والآن تقدمت تلك المسابقة إلى جولة إعادة جمهورية، وهي علامة على أن حقل الانتخابات الأولية الأولية كان مكتظاً بدرجة كافية بحيث لا يوجد مرشح واحد تجاوز الحد الأدنى المطلوب للفوز بشكل مباشر.

segments.src: Darline Graham entered the race carrying both an advantage and a burden.
segments.tr: دخلت دارلين جراهام السباق حاملة على عاتقها ميزة وعبء.

segments.src: The advantage is name recognition and the emotional resonance of continuing her brother's work; the burden is the perception, voiced by some rivals and commentators, that her rise to the Senate started with an appointment rather than a ballot box victory.
segments.tr: الميزة هي الاعتراف بالاسم والصدى العاطفي لمواصلة عمل أخيها؛ والعبء هو الإدراك، الذي أعرب عنه بعض المنافسين والمعلقين، بأن صعودها إلى مجلس الشيوخ بدأ بتعيين وليس بنصر صناديق الاقتراع.

segments.src: Her campaign has leaned into the former while trying to neutralize the latter, framing her appointment as a bridge to earning the seat directly from voters rather than an entitlement.
segments.tr: ركزت حملتها على الأول بينما حاولت تحييد الأخير، وإعادة تأطير تعيينها كجسر للحصول على المقعد مباشرة من الناخبين بدلاً من اعتباره حقاً مستحقاً.

segments.src: ## The Trump Factor
segments.tr: ## عامل ترامب

segments.src: The runoff has drawn outsized attention in part because of an endorsement from President Trump, who threw his support behind Graham's candidacy.
segments.tr: جذبت جولة الإعادة انتباهاً كبيراً جزئياً بسبب تأييد من الرئيس ترامب، الذي ألقى دعمه خلف ترشيح جراهام.

segments.src: In modern South Carolina Republican politics, a presidential endorsement can be decisive, often reshaping turnout and consolidating support among the party's base heading into a runoff.
segments.tr: في سياسة جمهورية ساوث كارولينا الحديثة، يمكن أن يكون التأييد الرئاسي حاسماً، مما يعيد تشكيل معدل التصويت غالباً ويوحد الدعم بين قاعدة الحزب في مسيرة نحو جولة إعادة.

segments.src: Graham's team has featured the endorsement prominently in campaign messaging, betting that it will help her fend off a challenger seeking to portray the race as a referendum on whether Senate seats should pass within a family rather than being won through a traditional political career.
segments.tr: قدمت فريق جراهام التأييد بشكل بارز في رسائل الحملة، متراهنة على أنه سيساعدها على صد منافس يسعى لتصوير السباق كاستفتاء على ما إذا كان يجب أن تنتقل مقاعد مجلس الشيوخ داخل الأسرة بدلاً من الفوز بها من خلال مسيرة سياسية تقليدية.

segments.src: Her runoff opponent has instead emphasized a message of earned service, arguing that voters deserve a senator who built a political record independent of a family name.
segments.tr: شدد منافسها في جولة الإعادة بدلاً من ذلك على رسالة الخدمة المستحقة، محتجاً بأن الناخبين يستحقون سيناتور بنى سجلاً سياسياً مستقلاً عن اسم عائلي.

segments.src: That argument has found some traction among South Carolina Republicans wary of dynastic politics, even within a party that has generally rallied around the Graham family since the senator's death.
segments.tr: وجدت تلك الحجة بعض القبول بين جمهوريي ساوث كارولينا الذين يحذرون من السياسة الأسرية، حتى داخل حزب تجمع عموماً حول عائلة جراهام منذ وفاة السيناتور.

segments.tr: ## ما الذي تقرره جولة الإعادة فعلاً

segments.src: Her supporters argue that a decisive runoff win, especially with a presidential endorsement in hand, would send a strong signal heading into that later contest.

segments.src: Whatever the outcome, the result will offer an early, closely watched signal of how South Carolina Republicans view the balance between honoring a political legacy and insisting that every seat in the Senate be won, not simply inherited.

pt.title: Nomeada, Apoiada, Ainda Não Eleita: O Combate de Darline Graham para Manter o Assento no Senado de seu Irmão

segments.src: ## A Seat Filled by Family, Now Facing the Voters
segments.tr: ## Um Assento Preenchido pela Família, Agora Enfrentando os Eleitores

segments.src: South Carolina's political calendar has an unusual date circled this month: August 25.
segments.tr: O calendário político da Carolina do Sul tem uma data inusitada marcada este mês: 25 de agosto.

segments.src: That is when Republican voters head back to the polls for a runoff that will decide who represents the state in the U.S.
segments.tr: É quando os eleitores republicanos voltam às urnas para um segundo turno que decidirá quem representa o estado nos EUA.

segments.src: Senate for the remainder of a term that began with tragedy and has continued under intense national scrutiny.
segments.tr: Senado pelo restante de um mandato que começou com tragédia e continuou sob intenso escrutínio nacional.

segments.src: The seat became vacant after Senator Lindsey Graham died while still in office, ending more than two decades of service in Washington.
segments.tr: O assento ficou vago após a morte do Senador Lindsey Graham enquanto ainda estava em exercício, encerrando mais de duas décadas de serviço em Washington.

segments.src: Under South Carolina's succession process, the governor was empowered to appoint a temporary replacement to serve until voters could weigh in through a special election.
segments.tr: Sob o processo de sucessão da Carolina do Sul, o governador foi autorizado a indicar um substituto temporário para servir até que os eleitores pudessem se pronunciar através de uma eleição especial.

segments.src: The choice fell to someone with an unmistakable personal connection to the seat: Darline Graham, the senator's sister.
segments.tr: A escolha recaiu sobre alguém com uma conexão pessoal inconfundível com o assento: Darline Graham, irmã do senador.

segments.src: ## From Appointment to Campaign Trail
segments.tr: ## Da Nomeação à Campanha Eleitoral

segments.src: Being appointed to fill a vacancy is one thing; winning the right to keep the job is another.
segments.tr: Ser nomeado para preencher uma vaga é uma coisa; ganhar o direito de manter o cargo é outra.

segments.src: South Carolina law requires a special election to fill the remainder of the term, and that contest has now advanced to a Republican runoff, a sign that the initial primary field was crowded enough that no single candidate cleared the threshold needed to win outright.
segments.tr: A lei da Carolina do Sul exige uma eleição especial para preencher o restante do mandato, e essa disputa agora avançou para um segundo turno republicano, sinal de que o campo de primárias inicial era tão lotado que nenhum candidato único ultrapassou o limite necessário para vencer de forma clara.

segments.src: Darline Graham entered the race carrying both an advantage and a burden.
segments.tr: Darline Graham entrou na corrida carregando tanto uma vantagem quanto um fardo.

segments.src: The advantage is name recognition and the emotional resonance of continuing her brother's work; the burden is the perception, voiced by some rivals and commentators, that her rise to the Senate started with an appointment rather than a ballot box victory.
segments.tr: A vantagem é o reconhecimento do nome e a ressonância emocional de continuar o trabalho de seu irmão; o fardo é a percepção, expressa por alguns rivais e comentaristas, de que sua ascensão ao Senado começou com uma nomeação em vez de uma vitória nas urnas.

segments.src: Her campaign has leaned into the former while trying to neutralize the latter, framing her appointment as a bridge to earning the seat directly from voters rather than an entitlement.
segments.tr: Sua campanha enfatizou o primeiro enquanto tentava neutralizar o segundo, enquadrando sua nomeação como uma ponte para ganhar o assento diretamente dos eleitores em vez de um direito adquirido.

segments.src: ## The Trump Factor
segments.tr: ## O Fator Trump

segments.src: The runoff has drawn outsized attention in part because of an endorsement from President Trump, who threw his support behind Graham's candidacy.
segments.tr: O segundo turno atraiu atenção desproporcional em parte por causa de um endosso do Presidente Trump, que apoiou a candidatura de Graham.

segments.src: In modern South Carolina Republican politics, a presidential endorsement can be decisive, often reshaping turnout and consolidating support among the party's base heading into a runoff.
segments.tr: Na política republicana moderna da Carolina do Sul, um endosso presidencial pode ser decisivo, frequentemente remodelando a participação e consolidando apoio entre a base do partido rumo ao segundo turno.

segments.src: Graham's team has featured the endorsement prominently in campaign messaging, betting that it will help her fend off a challenger seeking to portray the race as a referendum on whether Senate seats should pass within a family rather than being won through a traditional political career.
segments.tr: A equipe de Graham destacou o endosso proeminentemente nas mensagens de campanha, apostando que isso a ajudará a repelir um desafiante que busca retratar a corrida como um referendo sobre se os assentos do Senado devem passar dentro de uma família em vez de serem conquistados através de uma carreira política tradicional.

segments.src: Her runoff opponent has instead emphasized a message of earned service, arguing that voters deserve a senator who built a political record independent of a family name.
segments.tr: Seu oponente no segundo turno enfatizou uma mensagem de serviço conquistado, argumentando que os eleitores merecem um senador que construiu um histórico político independente de um nome de família.

segments.src: That argument has found some traction among South Carolina Republicans wary of dynastic politics, even within a party that has generally rallied around the Graham family since the senator's death.
segments.tr: Esse argumento encontrou alguma aceitação entre republicanos da Carolina do Sul céticos com a política dinástica, mesmo dentro de um partido que geralmente se uniu em torno da família Graham desde a morte do senador.

segments.src: ## What the Runoff Actually Decides
segments.tr: ## O que o Segundo Turno Realmente Decide

segments.src: It is worth being precise about what is, and is not, on the ballot August 25.
segments.tr: Vale ser preciso sobre o que está, e o que não está, na votação de 25 de agosto.

segments.src: The runoff will determine the Republican nominee for the special election to complete the remainder of Lindsey Graham's term, not a full six-year term in its own right.
segments.tr: O segundo turno determinará o indicado republicano para a eleição especial que completará o restante do mandato de Lindsey Graham, não um mandato completo de seis anos em si.

segments.src: Whoever wins the runoff will still need to prevail in the special general election against Democratic and any third-party candidates before formally winning the seat by vote rather than appointment.
segments.tr: Quem vencer o segundo turno ainda precisará prevalecer na eleição geral especial contra candidatos democráticos e de terceiros antes de ganhar formalmente o assento por voto em vez de nomeação.

segments.src: For Darline Graham, that means the political test is really twofold: first, consolidating Republican support in a state where the GOP nomination is often the decisive contest, and second, defending the seat again in the general election.
segments.tr: Para Darline Graham, isso significa que o teste político é realmente duplo: primeiro, consolidar o apoio republicano em um estado onde a nomeação do GOP é frequentemente o teste decisivo, e segundo, defender o assento novamente na eleição geral.

segments.src: Her supporters argue that a decisive runoff win, especially with a presidential endorsement in hand, would send a strong signal heading into that later contest.
segments.tr: Seus apoiadores argumentam que uma vitória decisiva no segundo turno, especialmente com um endosso presidencial em mãos, enviaria um sinal forte rumo àquele teste posterior.

segments.src: ## A Test of Legacy Politics in a Changing South Carolina
segments.tr: ## Um Teste da Política de Legado em uma Carolina do Sul em Mudança

segments.src: Beyond the personalities involved, the race has become something of a case study in how American voters respond to family succession in elected office, a dynamic more commonly associated with congressional dynasties in other states than with South Carolina's Senate seats.
segments.tr: Além das personalidades envolvidas, a corrida tornou-se uma espécie de estudo de caso sobre como os eleitores americanos respondem à sucessão familiar em cargos eleitos, uma dinâmica mais comumente associada a dinastias congressionais em outros estados do que aos assentos do Senado da Carolina do Sul.

segments.src: Political analysts have noted that appointed successors historically have a mixed track record when they later face voters directly, with outcomes often depending less on the family connection itself and more on how effectively the appointee builds an independent political identity during their time in office.
segments.tr: Analistas políticos observaram que sucessores indicados historicamente têm um histórico misto quando enfrentam diretamente os eleitores mais tarde, com resultados frequentemente dependendo menos da conexão familiar em si e mais de como efetivamente o indicado constrói uma identidade política independente durante seu tempo no cargo.

segments.src: Turnout in runoff elections tends to be lower and more ideologically driven than in primaries or general elections, which could amplify the impact of the Trump endorsement among the most engaged Republican voters.
segments.tr: A participação em eleições de segundo turno tende a ser menor e mais ideologicamente orientada do que em primárias ou eleições gerais, o que poderia amplificar o impacto do endosso de Trump entre os eleitores republicanos mais engajados.

segments.src: Local officials have urged residents to check their polling locations and eligibility ahead of the August 25 vote, since runoff participation rules can differ slightly from the initial primary.
segments.tr: Autoridades locais exortaram os residentes a verificar suas localidades de votação e elegibilidade antes da votação de 25 de agosto, já que as regras de participação no segundo turno podem diferir ligeiramente da primária inicial.

segments.src: Whatever the outcome, the result will offer an early, closely watched signal of how South Carolina Republicans view the balance between honoring a political legacy and insisting that every seat in the Senate be won, not simply inherited.
segments.tr: Qualquer que seja o resultado, o resultado oferecerá um sinal inicial e atentamente observado de como republicanos da Carolina do Sul veem o equilíbrio entre honrar um legado político e insistir que cada assento no Senado seja conquistado, não simplesmente herdado.

segments.tr: グラハムのチームは、キャンペーン・メッセージングで支持を目立つように取り上げ、それが上院議席が家族内で受け継がれるべきか、それとも伝統的な政治的キャリアを通じて勝つべきかについての国民投票としてレースを描写しようとしている挑戦者を撃退するのに役立つと期待している。

segments.src: Her runoff opponent has instead emphasized a message of earned service, arguing that voters deserve a senator who built a political record independent of a family name.
segments.tr: 彼女の決選投票の対戦相手は代わりに、獲得されたサービスのメッセージを強調し、有権者は家族の名前に独立した政治的記録を構築した上院議員に値すると主張している。

segments.src: That argument has found some traction among South Carolina Republicans wary of dynastic politics, even within a party that has generally rallied around the Graham family since the senator's death.
segments.tr: その議論は、王朝政治に警戒するサウスカロライナ州の共和党員の間でいくらかの支持を得ており、上院議員の死後、グラハム家の周りに一般的に集結した党の中でさえある。

segments.src: ## What the Runoff Actually Decides
segments.tr: ## 決選投票が実際に決めることは何か

segments.src: It is worth being precise about what is, and is not, on the ballot August 25.
segments.tr: 8月25日の投票で何が、そして何がないかについて正確であることは価値がある。

segments.src: The runoff will determine the Republican nominee for the special election to complete the remainder of Lindsey Graham's term, not a full six-year term in its own right.
segments.tr: 決選投票は、リンジー・グラハムの任期の残りを完成させるための特別選挙のための共和党の指名者を決定し、それ自体の完全な6年間の任期ではない。

segments.src: Whoever wins the runoff will still need to prevail in the special general election against Democratic and any third-party candidates before formally winning the seat by vote rather than appointment.
segments.tr: 決選投票に勝つ者は誰でも、指名ではなく投票で正式に議席を勝ち取る前に、民主党およびいかなる第三者候補者に対する特別総選挙で優位に立つ必要がある。

segments.src: For Darline Graham, that means the political test is really twofold: first, consolidating Republican support in a state where the GOP nomination is often the decisive contest, and second, defending the seat again in the general election.
segments.tr: ダーリン・グラハムにとって、それは政治的テストが本当に二つ折りであることを意味する：第一に、GOP指名がしばしば決定的な競争である州での共和党支持を統合し、第二に、総選挙で再び議席を守る。

segments.src: Her supporters argue that a decisive runoff win, especially with a presidential endorsement in hand, would send a strong signal heading into that later contest.
segments.tr: 彼女の支持者は、特に大統領の支持を手にした決定的な決選投票勝利が、その後の競争に向かって強いシグナルを送ると主張している。

segments.src: ## A Test of Legacy Politics in a Changing South Carolina
segments.tr: ## 変化するサウスカロライナ州でのレガシー政治のテスト

segments.src: Beyond the personalities involved, the race has become something of a case study in how American voters respond to family succession in elected office, a dynamic more commonly associated with congressional dynasties in other states than with South Carolina's Senate seats.
segments.tr: 関係する人物を超えて、このレースは、米国の有権者が選出されたオフィスでの家族継承にどのように対応するかについての事例研究になってしまった。これは、サウスカロライナ州の上院議席よりも、他の州の議会王朝とより一般的に関連付けられる動学である。

segments.src: Political analysts have noted that appointed successors historically have a mixed track record when they later face voters directly, with outcomes often depending less on the family connection itself and more on how effectively the appointee builds an independent political identity during their time in office.
segments.tr: 政治アナリストは、指名された後継者が後に投票者に直面する際に、歴史的に混合された実績を持っており、結果は多くの場合、家族の結びつき自体よりも、被任命者がオフィス中に独立した政治的アイデンティティをどれだけ効果的に構築するかに依存していることに注目している。

segments.src: Turnout in runoff elections tends to be lower and more ideologically driven than in primaries or general elections, which could amplify the impact of the Trump endorsement among the most engaged Republican voters.
segments.tr: 決選投票での投票率は、予選または総選挙よりも低く、より思想的に駆動される傾向があり、これは最も関与している共和党支持者の間でトランプの支持の影響を増幅する可能性がある。

segments.src: Local officials have urged residents to check their polling locations and eligibility ahead of the August 25 vote, since runoff participation rules can differ slightly from the initial primary.
segments.tr: 地方当局は、決選投票参加ルールが初期予選とわずかに異なる可能性があるため、8月25日の投票前に投票場所と適格性を確認するよう住民に促した。

segments.src: Whatever the outcome, the result will offer an early, closely watched signal of how South Carolina Republicans view the balance between honoring a political legacy and insisting that every seat in the Senate be won, not simply inherited.
segments.tr: 結果がどうであれ、その結果は、サウスカロライナ州の共和党員が政治的遺産を尊重することと、上院のすべての議席が単に受け継がれるのではなく、勝ち取られるべきだと主張することの間のバランスをどのように見るかについての早期で、密接に観察されたシグナルを提供するであろう。

de.title: Ernannt, unterstützt, noch nicht gewählt: Der Kampf von Darline Graham um den Senatssitz ihres Bruders

segments.src: ## A Seat Filled by Family, Now Facing the Voters
segments.tr: ## Ein Sitz, der von der Familie besetzt ist, und nun den Wählern gegenübersteht

segments.src: South Carolina's political calendar has an unusual date circled this month: August 25.
segments.tr: South Carolinas Wahlkalender hat in diesem Monat ein ungewöhnliches Datum: August 25.

segments.src: That is when Republican voters head back to the polls for a runoff that will decide who represents the state in the U.S.
segments.tr: Das ist der Zeitpunkt, zu dem republikanische Wähler zurück an die Urnen gehen, um eine Stichwahl abzuhalten, die entscheidet, wer den Staat im U.S.

segments.src: Senate for the remainder of a term that began with tragedy and has continued under intense national scrutiny.
segments.tr: Senat für den Rest einer Amtszeit vertreten wird, die mit einer Tragödie begann und unter intensiver nationaler Beobachtung fortgesetzt wurde.

segments.src: The seat became vacant after Senator Lindsey Graham died while still in office, ending more than two decades of service in Washington.
segments.tr: Der Sitz wurde frei, nachdem Senator Lindsey Graham starb, während er noch im Amt war, was mehr als zwei Jahrzehnte Dienst in Washington beendete.

segments.src: Under South Carolina's succession process, the governor was empowered to appoint a temporary replacement to serve until voters could weigh in through a special election.
segments.tr: Unter South Carolinas Sukzessionsregelung war der Gouverneur ermächtigt, einen vorübergehenden Ersatz zu ernennen, um zu dienen, bis die Wähler durch eine Sonderwahl abstimmen konnten.

segments.src: The choice fell to someone with an unmistakable personal connection to the seat: Darline Graham, the senator's sister.
segments.tr: Die Wahl fiel auf jemanden mit einer unverkennbaren persönlichen Verbindung zum Sitz: Darline Graham, die Schwester des Senators.

segments.src: ## From Appointment to Campaign Trail
segments.tr: ## Von der Ernennung zum Wahlkampf

segments.src: Being appointed to fill a vacancy is one thing; winning the right to keep the job is another.
segments.tr: Ernannt zu werden, um einen Sitz zu besetzen, ist eine Sache; sich das Recht zu verdienen, ihn zu behalten, eine ganz andere.

segments.src: South Carolina law requires a special election to fill the remainder of the term, and that contest has now advanced to a Republican runoff, a sign that the initial primary field was crowded enough that no single candidate cleared the threshold needed to win outright.
segments.tr: Das Gesetz von South Carolina verlangt eine Sonderwahl, um den Rest der Amtszeit zu besetzen, und dieser Wettbewerb ist nun zu einer republikanischen Stichwahl vorangekommen, ein Zeichen dafür, dass das ursprüngliche Primärfeld so viele Kandidaten enthielt, dass kein einzelner Kandidat die erforderliche Schwelle zum direkten Gewinnen erreichte.

segments.src: Darline Graham entered the race carrying both an advantage and a burden.
segments.tr: Darline Graham trat ins Rennen mit sowohl einem Vorteil als auch einer Belastung.

segments.src: The advantage is name recognition and the emotional resonance of continuing her brother's work; the burden is the perception, voiced by some rivals and commentators, that her rise to the Senate started with an appointment rather than a ballot box victory.
segments.tr: Der Vorteil ist die Namensbekannheit und die emotionale Resonanz der Fortführung der Arbeit ihres Bruders; die Belastung ist die Wahrnehmung, die von einigen Rivalen und Kommentatoren geäußert wird, dass ihr Aufstieg zum Senat mit einer Ernennung anstatt mit einem Wahlerfolg begann.

segments.src: Her campaign has leaned into the former while trying to neutralize the latter, framing her appointment as a bridge to earning the seat directly from voters rather than an entitlement.
segments.tr: Ihr Wahlkampf hat sich auf das Erstere konzentriert und versucht, das Letztere zu neutralisieren, indem ihre Ernennung als Brücke zum direkten Verdienen des Sitzes von den Wählern dargestellt wird, anstatt als etwas, auf das sie Anspruch hat.

segments.src: ## The Trump Factor
segments.tr: ## Der Trump-Faktor

segments.src: The runoff has drawn outsized attention in part because of an endorsement from President Trump, who threw his support behind Graham's candidacy.
segments.tr: Die Stichwahl hat teilweise deshalb übergroße Aufmerksamkeit gezogen, weil Präsident Trump Grahams Kandidatur unterstützte.

segments.src: In modern South Carolina Republican politics, a presidential endorsement can be decisive, often reshaping turnout and consolidating support among the party's base heading into a runoff.
segments.tr: In der modernen republikanischen Politik von South Carolina kann eine präsidentielle Unterstützung entscheidend sein und oft die Wahlbeteiligung umgestalten sowie die Unterstützung der Parteibasis vor einer Stichwahl konsolidieren.

segments.src: Graham's team has featured the endorsement prominently in campaign messaging, betting that it will help her fend off a challenger seeking to portray the race as a referendum on whether Senate seats should pass within a family rather than being won through a traditional political career.
segments.tr: Grahams Team hat die Unterstützung prominent in den Wahlkampfbotschaften dargestellt und hofft, dass dies ihr hilft, einen Gegner abzuwehren, der das Rennen als ein Referendum darüber darstellen möchte, ob Senatssitze innerhalb einer Familie weitergegeben werden sollten, anstatt durch eine traditionelle politische Karriere gewonnen zu werden.

segments.src: Her runoff opponent has instead emphasized a message of earned service, arguing that voters deserve a senator who built a political record independent of a family name.
segments.tr: Ihr Stichwahl-Gegner hat stattdessen eine Botschaft verdienter Dienstleistung betont und argumentiert, dass die Wähler einen Senator verdienen, der eine politische Bilanz unabhängig von einem Familiennamen aufgebaut hat.

segments.src: That argument has found some traction among South Carolina Republicans wary of dynastic politics, even within a party that has generally rallied around the Graham family since the senator's death.
segments.tr: Dieses Argument hat einige Unterstützung unter South Carolina-Republikanern gefunden, die vor dynastischer Politik vorsichtig sind, sogar innerhalb einer Partei, die sich seit dem Tod des Senators allgemein um die Graham-Familie versammelt hat.

segments.src: ## What the Runoff Actually Decides
segments.tr: ## Was die Stichwahl tatsächlich entscheidet

segments.src: It is worth being precise about what is, and is not, on the ballot August 25.
segments.tr: Es ist wichtig, genau zu unterscheiden, was bei der Abstimmung August 25 auf dem Stimmzettel enthalten ist und was nicht.

segments.src: The runoff will determine the Republican nominee for the special election to complete the remainder of Lindsey Graham's term, not a full six-year term in its own right.
segments.tr: Die Stichwahl wird den republikanischen Kandidaten für die Sonderwahl bestimmen, um den Rest von Lindsey Grahams Amtszeit abzuschließen, nicht eine vollständige sechsjährige Amtszeit im eigentlichen Sinne.

segments.src: Whoever wins the runoff will still need to prevail in the special general election against Democratic and any third-party candidates before formally winning the seat by vote rather than appointment.
segments.tr: Wer die Stichwahl gewinnt, muss immer noch in der Sonderwahl gegen demokratische und Kandidaten von Drittparteien gewinnen, bevor er formal den Sitz durch Abstimmung anstatt durch Ernennung erhält.

segments.src: For Darline Graham, that means the political test is really twofold: first, consolidating Republican support in a state where the GOP nomination is often the decisive contest, and second, defending the seat again in the general election.
segments.tr: Für Darline Graham bedeutet das, dass der politische Test wirklich zweigeteilt ist: erstens, die republikanische Unterstützung in einem Staat zu konsolidieren, in dem die GOP-Nominierung oft der entscheidende Wettbewerb ist, und zweitens, den Sitz erneut in der Allgemeinwahl zu verteidigen.

segments.src: Her supporters argue that a decisive runoff win, especially with a presidential endorsement in hand, would send a strong signal heading into that later contest.
segments.tr: Ihre Unterstützer argumentieren, dass ein entscheidender Stichwahl-Sieg, besonders mit einer präsidentiellen Unterstützung, ein starkes Signal vor jenem späteren Wettbewerb senden würde.

segments.src: ## A Test of Legacy Politics in a Changing South Carolina
segments.tr: ## Ein Test der Vermächtnispolitik in einem sich verändernden South Carolina

segments.src: Beyond the personalities involved, the race has become something of a case study in how American voters respond to family succession in elected office, a dynamic more commonly associated with congressional dynasties in other states than with South Carolina's Senate seats.
segments.tr: Über die beteiligten Persönlichkeiten hinaus ist das Rennen zu einer Art Fallstudie darüber geworden, wie amerikanische Wähler auf Familiensukzession in Wahlämtern reagieren, eine Dynamik, die eher mit Kongressdynastien in anderen Staaten verbunden ist als mit South Carolinas Senatssitzen.

segments.src: Political analysts have noted that appointed successors historically have a mixed track record when they later face voters directly, with outcomes often depending less on the family connection itself and more on how effectively the appointee builds an independent political identity during their time in office.
segments.tr: Politische Analysten haben festgestellt, dass ernannte Nachfolger historisch eine gemischte Bilanz aufweisen, wenn sie sich später direkt den Wählern stellen müssen, wobei die Ergebnisse oft weniger von der Familienverbindung selbst abhängen und mehr davon, wie effektiv der Ernannte während seiner Amtszeit eine unabhängige politische Identität aufbaut.

segments.src: Turnout in runoff elections tends to be lower and more ideologically driven than in primaries or general elections, which could amplify the impact of the Trump endorsement among the most engaged Republican voters.
segments.tr: Die Wahlbeteiligung in Stichwahlen ist tendenziell niedriger und ideologisch getrieben als bei Vorwahlen oder Allgemeinwahlen, was die Auswirkung der Trump-Unterstützung unter den am meisten engagierten republikanischen Wählern verstärken könnte.

segments.src: Local officials have urged residents to check their polling locations and eligibility ahead of the August 25 vote, since runoff participation rules can differ slightly from the initial primary.
segments.tr: Lokale Beamte haben die Bewohner aufgefordert, ihre Wahllokale und Wählbarkeit vor der Abstimmung August 25 zu überprüfen, da sich die Teilnahmeregeln bei Stichwahlen leicht von der ursprünglichen Vorwahl unterscheiden können.

segments.src: Whatever the outcome, the result will offer an early, closely watched signal of how South Carolina Republicans view the balance between honoring a political legacy and insisting that every seat in the Senate be won, not simply inherited.
segments.tr: Unabhängig vom Ergebnis wird das Ergebnis ein frühes, genau beobachtetes Signal bieten, wie Republikaner in South Carolina das Gleichgewicht zwischen der Ehrung eines politischen Vermächtnisses und der Insistenz, dass jeder Senatssitz gewonnen werden muss, nicht einfach vererbt wird, betrachten.

segments.tr: ## Vòng Bầu Cử Lần Hai Thực Sự Quyết Định Cái Gì

segments.src: It is worth being precise about what is, and is not, on the ballot August 25.
segments.tr: Điều đáng để xác định chính xác những gì có và không có trên phiếu bầu ngày 25 tháng 8.

segments.src: The runoff will determine the Republican nominee for the special election to complete the remainder of Lindsey Graham's term, not a full six-year term in its own right.
segments.tr: Vòng bầu cử lần hai sẽ xác định ứng cử viên Cộng Hòa cho cuộc bầu cử đặc biệt để hoàn thành phần còn lại của nhiệm kỳ của Lindsey Graham, không phải một nhiệm kỳ sáu năm đầy đủ trong chính nó.

segments.src: Whoever wins the runoff will still need to prevail in the special general election against Democratic and any third-party candidates before formally winning the seat by vote rather than appointment.
segments.tr: Ai thắng vòng bầu cử lần hai sẽ vẫn phải thắng trong cuộc bầu cử đặc biệt chống lại các ứng cử viên Dân chủ và bên thứ ba trước khi chính thức giành ghế bằng phiếu bầu chứ không phải bổ nhiệm.

segments.src: For Darline Graham, that means the political test is really twofold: first, consolidating Republican support in a state where the GOP nomination is often the decisive contest, and second, defending the seat again in the general election.
segments.tr: Đối với Darline Graham, điều đó có nghĩa là bài kiểm tra chính trị thực sự gồm hai phần: thứ nhất, củng cố sự ủng hộ Cộng Hòa ở một tiểu bang nơi đề cử GOP thường là cuộc thi quyết định, và thứ hai, bảo vệ ghế lại trong cuộc bầu cử tổng quát.

segments.src: Her supporters argue that a decisive runoff win, especially with a presidential endorsement in hand, would send a strong signal heading into that later contest.
segments.tr: Những người ủng hộ cô lập luận rằng một chiến thắng quyết định trong vòng bầu cử lần hai, đặc biệt là với sự ủng hộ của tổng thống, sẽ gửi một tín hiệu mạnh mẽ cho cuộc thi sau đó.

segments.src: ## A Test of Legacy Politics in a Changing South Carolina
segments.tr: ## Một Bài Kiểm Tra Chính Trị Di Sản Trong South Carolina Đang Thay Đổi

segments.src: Beyond the personalities involved, the race has become something of a case study in how American voters respond to family succession in elected office, a dynamic more commonly associated with congressional dynasties in other states than with South Carolina's Senate seats.
segments.tr: Vượt ra ngoài những cá nhân liên quan, cuộc đua đã trở thành một trường hợp nghiên cứu về cách những cử tri Mỹ phản ứng với sự kế thừa gia đình trong các chức vụ được bầu cử, một động thái thường liên quan nhiều hơn đến các triều đại quốc hội ở các tiểu bang khác so với các ghế Thượng Viện của South Carolina.

segments.src: Political analysts have noted that appointed successors historically have a mixed track record when they later face voters directly, with outcomes often depending less on the family connection itself and more on how effectively the appointee builds an independent political identity during their time in office.
segments.tr: Các nhà phân tích chính trị đã chỉ ra rằng những người kế vị được bổ nhiệm trong lịch sử có hồ sơ theo dõi hỗn hợp khi họ sau đó đối mặt với cử tri trực tiếp, với kết quả thường phụ thuộc ít hơn vào bản thân mối liên hệ gia đình và nhiều hơn vào cách người được bổ nhiệm xây dựng nhận dạng chính trị độc lập hiệu quả trong thời gian đương chức.

segments.src: Turnout in runoff elections tends to be lower and more ideologically driven than in primaries or general elections, which could amplify the impact of the Trump endorsement among the most engaged Republican voters.
segments.tr: Tỷ lệ bỏ phiếu trong các cuộc bầu cử lần hai có xu hướng thấp hơn và chịu ảnh hưởng ý thức hệ nhiều hơn so với các cuộc bầu cử sơ cấp hoặc tổng quát, điều này có thể khuếch đại tác động của sự ủng hộ Trump trong số những cử tri Cộng Hòa tích cực nhất.

segments.src: Local officials have urged residents to check their polling locations and eligibility ahead of the August 25 vote, since runoff participation rules can differ slightly from the initial primary.
segments.tr: Các quan chức địa phương đã kêu gọi cư dân kiểm tra địa điểm bầu cử và đủ điều kiện của họ trước cuộc bỏ phiếu ngày 25 tháng 8, vì các quy tắc tham gia vòng bầu cử lần hai có thể khác một chút so với cuộc sơ cấp ban đầu.

segments.src: Whatever the outcome, the result will offer an early, closely watched signal of how South Carolina Republicans view the balance between honoring a political legacy and insisting that every seat in the Senate be won, not simply inherited.
segments.tr: Dù kết quả như thế nào, kết quả sẽ cung cấp một tín hiệu sớm, được theo dõi chặt chẽ về cách những người Cộng Hòa South Carolina nhìn nhận sự cân bằng giữa tôn vinh di sản chính trị và khẩng khẩng rằng mỗi ghế trong Thượng Viện phải được giành chiến thắng, không đơn giản là được thừa kế.
